description: Reverse lock_channel: lift the denials the lock added and put back what it took off, leaving alone anything that was denied before the lock. A channel that was read-only before it was locked stays read-only. On a channel no lock is on record for, it would remove everyone's denial on sending, which may be there on purpose, so that needs confirming: the first call changes nothing and returns a preview and a confirm_token, and repeating the call with the token makes the change.

confirm_token.description: The token from this exact action's preview. Where the app can show a confirmation dialog, calling with it asks the user there, and it happens only if they agree.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

reason.description: The reason recorded in the server's audit log.

name: unlock_channel
title: Unlock channel
